title: Playboy July 2007 Amanda Beard Bruce Willis Danica Patrick Complete Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Front clean and bright; back cover has edge wear with small creases and nicks along the bottom edge. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, July 2007 Red-Hot Summer Issue. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Olympic swimmer Amanda Beard.

Cover features: Olympic gold medalist Amanda Beard pictorial; Bruce Willis interview - lives hard; 20Q with Danica Patrick - drives fast; Erik Hedegaard in Las Vegas; drinking, grilling and road-tripping; fiction by Jamie Malanowski; the Summer of Love and the rise of crystal meth; Girls of Montauk.

Back cover: Absolut vodka 'In an Absolut World' ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
